seo.title: Focus Easy — A Quiet Launcher for iPhone
seo.description: A quiet iPhone launcher: your few essential apps in plain type, one tap each. Contexts for each part of your day, a Home Screen widget, and Focus filters. No accounts, no tracking.

hero.label: MINIMALIST LAUNCHER
hero.title: Fewer apps, one tap away.
text: A quiet launcher for iPhone. Pick the few apps you need, group them by part of your day, and give them a Home Screen page of their own. Ink on paper, with no badges calling for you.

items.title: Your apps in plain type
items.text: The launcher shows your essential apps as big, plain names. Tap one and it opens. No icons, no badges, nothing else.

items.title: Contexts for your day
items.text: A set of apps for Everyday, Work, Evening or the weekend. Switch in a tap, from the launcher or the menu.

items.title: A widget with a page of its own
items.text: Small, medium or large. Each widget follows your current context or shows one you pick.

items.title: Works with Focus
items.text: Show only your quiet page while a Focus is on, and let a Focus filter switch Focus Easy to the right context.

items.title: Any app
items.text: Add the apps on your iPhone in a tap. Apps with no link, like Phone or Camera, open through a shortcut you make once.

items.title: See what you reach for
items.text: Usage counts the apps you open through Focus Easy this week. It doesn't read Screen Time, and it stays on your iPhone.

sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No account. Focus Easy makes no network requests, and your apps, contexts and counts stay on your iPhone.

sections.label: PHILOSOPHY
sections.title: Less is more.
text: Your Home Screen is visual noise: dozens of colorful icons competing for attention, badges asking to be cleared, apps you forgot you installed.
Focus Easy replaces that with a quiet page. Ink on paper, in Light, Graphite or Black. Just the apps you actually need, and one accent that marks the context you're in.
Inspired by the dumb phone movement and digital minimalism, Focus Easy helps you use your phone on purpose, not by habit.

cta.title: Quiet your Home Screen.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
